selection_criteria: stratified by domain proportional to total event count across 6 domains (urban_renewal=2, education=2, healthcare=2, public_safety=2, urban_mobility=1, digital_governance=1); all 10 events have human-verified gold labels from human_gold_tuples_v2.jsonl; mix of gold tuple counts (2, 3, 4, 5) for complexity balance; events NOT selected from the original 5 pre-marked test events (which lacked gold labels)
notes: The 5 previously-marked test events (E002/E008/E016/E018/E041) had no gold labels and were converted to split=dev with held_out=false. The held-out test set of 10 events uses ONLY events with existing gold labels, preserving the gold dataset unchanged per guardrail G3.
